lede: The plans of the Speechify text to speech app, what Free and Premium include, and what Premium costs billed monthly or yearly.

plans.name: Premium
features: Google Drive, Dropbox, Microsoft OneDrive integrations

after_plans: Premium is the only paid plan, and the pricing page lists no usage limit for it. Speechify also sells a text to speech API for developers, from $10/month (plus a free plan), and Speechify Studio, for voiceovers and dubbing, from $100 a year.

compare.What you pay for: A subscription to the Speechify text to speech app
compare.Free option: Free: 10 robotic sounding voices, speeds up to 1.5x, text to speech features only
compare.Most on a public plan: Premium is the only paid plan: 1000+ voices, 60+ languages, speeds up to 5x
compare.Usage above the plan: No usage limit listed on the pricing page
compare.Yearly billing: $139 a year instead of $29 a month (Speechify says save 60%)

faq: Speechify has a Free plan and one paid plan, Premium. Premium is $29/month billed monthly, or $139 billed yearly, which Speechify says saves 60%.
What does the free Speechify plan include?
Free lets you listen anywhere at speeds up to 1.5x, with 10 robotic sounding voices. It covers text to speech features only.
What do you get with Speechify Premium?

1000+ high quality, natural voices in 60+ languages, listening at up to 5x speed, Scan & Listen, AI summaries and chats, Google Drive, Dropbox and Microsoft OneDrive integrations, voice typing, AI podcasts and the Voice AI Assistant.
Is the Speechify app the same as the Speechify API or Studio?
No. The text to speech API for developers and Speechify Studio, for voiceovers and dubbing, each have their own pricing page and are billed separately from the app.
